map.本工具对机械部件做三项力学性能检测与合格判定:: This tool performs three mechanical-property tests and pass/fail judgment on machine parts:
map.:k = F / δ(载荷 / 变形量,胡克定律),反映抗变形能力。: : k = F / δ (load / deflection, Hooke's law), reflecting deformation resistance.
map.:依据标准(如 GB/T 1448 玻璃钢弯曲、GB/T 307 滚动轴承)判定: : judged against standards (e.g. GB/T 1448 FRP bending, GB/T 307 rolling bearing) for allowable values.
map.⚠️ 仅作工程估算与自检参考,正式判定与出报告须由具备资质的第三方检测机构完成。: ⚠️ For engineering estimation and self-check only; formal judgment and reports must be done by a qualified third-party lab.
map.本工具用于检测（刚度/载荷/疲劳）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates (stiffness/load/fatigue) testing inputs against format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; pure front-end, no upload.
map.📚 深度解析：机械部件三项力学性能判定（刚度/载荷/疲劳）: 📚 Deep Dive: Machine-Part Three Mechanical Tests (Stiffness/Load/Fatigue)
map.机械部件自检：按刚度、额定载荷、疲劳寿命三项判定: Machine-part self-check: judge by stiffness, rated load and fatigue life
map.安全裕度：疲劳寿命是耐久核心: Safety margin: fatigue life is the durability core
map.重要提示：结果仅为工程估算，正式报告须第三方完成: Important: results are engineering estimates only; formal reports need a third party
map.逐项判定：刚度≥100N/mm、额定载荷≥50kN、疲劳寿命≥1×10⁶ 次；三: Item-by-item: stiffness ≥100 N/mm, rated load ≥50 kN, fatigue life ≥1×10⁶ cycles; all pass → qualified. Stiffness reflects deformation resistance; fatigue life is estimated from the S-N curve.
map.刚度 120N/mm（≥100 ✓）、额定载荷 60kN（≥50 ✓）、疲劳 2: Stiffness 120 N/mm (≥100 ✓), rated load 60 kN (≥50 ✓), fatigue 2×10⁶ cycles (≥1×10⁶ ✓): all pass → qualified. If stiffness drops to 80 N/mm it fails, too much deformation.
map.疲劳寿命 1×10⁶ 次够吗？: Is 1×10⁶ cycles of fatigue life enough?
map.该值为示例合格下限，对应中等寿命等级；关键承力件常要求更高（如 10⁷ 次），须: That is an example pass floor for a medium life grade; critical load-bearing parts often require more (e.g. 10⁷ cycles), set by design life and load spectrum.
map.不能，本工具按三项阈值做快速自检演示；真实部件须做 FE 分析、试验与第三方鉴定: No — this tool is a quick self-check demo against three thresholds; real parts need FE analysis, testing and third-party qualification, especially under dynamic/cyclic loads.
map.刚度测试需在弹性范围内加载卸载: Stiffness testing needs load/unload within the elastic range
map.疲劳寿命试验需模拟实际工况载荷谱: Fatigue-life testing needs the real load spectrum
map.机械部件刚度、额定载荷、疲劳寿命三项检测工具，依据GB/T 1448、GB/T: A three-item tester for machine-part stiffness, rated load and fatigue life, judged by GB/T 1448, GB/T 307. For mechanical structures, connectors and similar parts mechanical testing and life assessment.
map.支持刚度、额定载荷、疲劳寿命等多项指标检测: Supports stiffness, rated load, fatigue life and more
